text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A live show that newcomers and longtime fans alike could enjoy—
The day of the event Hokko Tarumae had spoken of finally arrived.

text_block_list.name: Tarumae Fan A
text_block_list.text:
There are tons of people today, aren't there?
Must be because of that web drama, right?

text_block_list.name: Tarumae Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Totally. It blew up after Curren Chan promoted it,
so of course the crowd grew!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Searching online, I found a web drama titled "Tomakoi!".
Apparently, it was Hokko Tarumae herself who pitched the project.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The plot followed 'a girl farming in Tomakomai who falls in love with a wandering magician.'
In other words, she had—
choice_data_list: (Used the drama to draw in new visitors!)

text_block_list.text:
Oh, look who it is!
You came too!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey, did ya watch "Tomakoi!"?
I helped out with the heroine's farming scenes, ya know!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Curren gave advice on the romance scenes♪
If you haven't seen it yet, check it out after the live~☆

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I didn't touch "Tomakoi!",
but I handled the prep for the live... Ah, here it comes.
Please, go well...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Looking up, a large box had been placed on the stage without anyone noticing—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Yoo-hoo~!
All the way from Tomakomai~~!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~~♪
Magic trick was a huge success, yeah~~!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Hao! Timing her jump out of the box was so tricky...!
I'm so glad it succeeded~!

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text: What's going on? Did a magic show just start?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
We're just getting started!
Here we go, a surf clam out of the hat!

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, seriously!?
Hey hey, let's watch for a bit!

text_block_list.name: Tarumae Fan C
text_block_list.text:
That magic trick was the one from the drama!
Tarumae-chan can do it in real life too—!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Hello everyone, I'm Hokko Tarumae!
Tomakomai Tourism Ambassador and locodol♪

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
To those meeting me for the first time,
and to all the fans who always support me!
Please enjoy today's live show~!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Now for the first song: the theme song from the hit streaming show,
"Tomakoi!"! Sing along if you know the words~♪

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
Man, this song is so good~!
It matches the heroine's feelings perfectly, I totally cried when it played in the show!

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Huh, it really is a nice tune.
Maybe I'll give "Tomakoi!" a watch too.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
The vegetables featured in the drama
will be on sale directly at the venue later!
Please feel free to check them out~♪

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Safe and fresh, grown right in Tomakomai! They come with special messages
from the producers and the drama's heroines!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During an intermission in the live show while I was grabbing a drink,
Hokko Tarumae quietly walked up to me.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san, you came after all!
!
choice_data_list: Looks like everything is going just as planned.
Looks like things are working out just as planned.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, it's way beyond what I expected!
To think this many people would show up...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I just charged ahead with the single-minded wish
to let everyone know about Tomakomai, but...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ah, of course it's thanks to everyone's help!
I never could have accomplished this on my own.
choice_data_list: Looks like it'll end on a huge high note.
Looks like it'll turn out to be a massive success.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
Even when this live is over, my idol journey will keep going—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Just like Curren-chan said,
I have to keep entertaining everyone from here on out!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
My new path has only just begun!
From here on is where the real hard work starts!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days after the live show—I discovered a basket
packed full of fruits and vegetables sitting on my desk
in the Trainer's Office.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you so very much for the other day.
The live show was only able to be a huge success
thanks to you, Trainer-san, and everyone else."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"I wanted to put my feelings of gratitude into shape,
so please accept this gift."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"These vegetables and fruits are actually the ones
we grew during the drama shoot.
They're super delicious, so please enjoy them!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Corn, haskap berries—indeed, everything looked
absolutely delicious. Thankful to both her and Tomakomai,
I gladly decided to dig in.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much for watching the live until the very end~!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Please keep supporting both Tomakomai
and Hokko Tarumae from here on out, too~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was an incredible live show, wildly exciting
right until the very end.
I look forward to seeing what great things she'll achieve next.
